title: S&P 500
source: Yahoo ^GSPC, FRED SP500, datasets/gold-prices monthly, Yahoo GC=F
description: S&P 500 in dollars and the same index priced in ounces of gold.
summary: The white line is the S&P 500 in dollars. The gold line is that same index divided by the dollar price of an ounce of gold — how many ounces the index is worth. When the gold line falls, stocks are losing to metal even if the dollar index is making new highs. On the click-through chart, the 200-day moving average is the ordinary trailing average of the dollar index. Toggle the extra lines on and off there.
